summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.26/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.26 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 26, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 11¢ lower than a week ago, 44¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.49 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($4.09) and the highest in Marshfield ($4.39).
